structured_output.summary: The Set constructor follows the spec order: TypeError when NewTarget is undefined, then create_collection (OrdinaryCreateFromConstructor with [[SetData]]), the nullish-iterable early return, Get(set, "add") and the IsCallable check, then GetIterator. The loop uses IteratorStepValue with ? propagation and closes the iterator via iterator_close only when Call fails, which matches IfAbruptCloseIterator. The "add" lookup is observable and happens once. The only structural difference from the stub is that steps 7-8 are moved into a private helper, add_values_from_iterable, which matches the current ECMA-262 AddValuesFromIterable split. The helper is not visible in the ticket text but is behaviourally equivalent. No test-shaped branches, no swallowed errors, no made-up values. The gate report is clean (build and clippy OK, 34 new passes, no regressions). I could not inspect support::collections or ops, so I am assuming create_collection and iterator_close behave as their names and signatures suggest.
